description: A white rectangular base tray with two round recesses sits on a green cloth surface, with a small white block standing upright near the tray’s right side. The left hand steadies the tray at its left edge as the right hand grasps the upright block, nudges and rotates it in place on its peg, then lifts it off and moves it to the right to set it down on the green surface, leaving the tray clear.
